name: River Development Agent Operation Execution Authorization Foundation
architecture: GENERATION III OPERATION EXECUTION AUTHORIZATION FOUNDATION
invariants: DEV-274 consumes only the exact DEV-273 controlled-executor-invocation result contract.
DEV-274 denies operation-execution authorization when the predecessor is malformed, untrusted, unready, not invoked, blocked, or inconsistent.
DEV-274 represents operation-execution authorization as deterministic inert data.
DEV-274 does not call an executor implementation.
DEV-274 does not execute the authorized operation.
DEV-274 does not invoke repository inspection or any other execution dependency.
DEV-274 grants no repository mutation authority.
DEV-274 grants no shell, process, network, deployment, secret-access, scope-expansion, or external-side-effect authority.

DEV-274 preserves validated predecessor provenance, scope, receipt, operation, authorization, admission, eligibility, consumption, dispatch, invocation authorization, and invocation evidence only after exact predecessor validation.
Rejected predecessor payloads release no trusted predecessor payload.
Actual operation execution requires a future explicit controlled operation execution boundary.
